name: php5-to-8-upgrade-v2
description: PHP 5 to 8.5 upgrade pipeline with compatibility checking, auto-fixes, modernization, and type checking

steps.name: CodeGraph index
steps.description: Build CodeGraph analysis index if not present

steps.name: Find problems
steps.description: Run composer compat:report to identify compatibility issues

steps.name: Auto-fix with PHPCBF
steps.description: Run composer compat:phpcbf to auto-fix compatibility problems

steps.name: Modernize with Rector
steps.description: Run composer rector:report to modernize code

steps.name: Type check with PHPStan
steps.description: Run composer stan:report for type checking

git-gate.description: Validate git diff after upgrade steps
